title: Unconditional structure of Banach spaces with few operators
summary: This article was initially motivated by our goal to show that the Banach space $\mathbb{G}$ constructed by Gowers in [W. T. Gowers, A solution to Banach's hyperplane problem, Bull. London Math. Soc. 26 (1994), no. 6, 523-530] to settle Banach's hyperplane problem has a unique unconditional basis. This uniqueness result served as a springboard to ask whether further structural insights could be derived by rigging Gowers' original construction.
